title: Gap and Victoria Beckham Unveil Their Second Collection for Fall/Winter 2026
body_markdown:
# Gap and Victoria Beckham Unveil Their Second Collection for Fall/Winter 2026


by Gap


[Gap](https://www.gapinc.com/en-us/news/gap)


October 20, 2026


*Following the success of their inaugural Spring collection, the latest chapter builds upon the brands’ shared vision for the modern wardrobe*


Gap and Victoria Beckham unveil their Fall/Winter 2026 collection, bringing together Gap’s iconic American style and Victoria Beckham’s distinctive design perspective. The 37-piece collection features refined knitwear in cashmere, merino wool and Gap’s signature CashSoft, alongside statement outerwear, considered tailoring and fresh expressions of Gap denim. Versatile silhouettes and thoughtful details offer a new take on everyday dressing.


“For this second drop, we wanted to build on the design language we established in the first collection, with a stronger focus on texture, proportion and layering, while keeping the ease and versatility that feels so intrinsic to Gap,” says Victoria Beckham. “Each piece was designed to work as part of a modern wardrobe—refined and considered, but still effortless and made to be worn in many different ways.”


“From the start, we envisioned this partnership in two chapters, allowing us to build on the strong foundation of the first collection and go even further with the second,” said Mark Breitbard, President and CEO of Gap. “The strong customer response to the Spring collection reinforced what we believed from the beginning: Victoria Beckham's distinct design perspective brings a fresh lens to Gap's iconic essentials, and this collection builds on that momentum with elevated wardrobe staples designed for everyday wear.”


Knits take center stage this fall, bringing warmth, texture and sophistication through Merino Turtleneck Sweaters ($118), High-Neck Pullovers in Gap’s signature CashSoft ($148) and Wool-Cashmere Zip Sweaters ($228). Outerwear anchors the collection with Oversized Parka Jacket, Oversized Satin Bomber Jackets and Wool-Blend Chesterfield Coats ranging from $198–$368. Building on the success of the Spring collection, new expressions of Gap denim include High-Rise Straight Jeans – a Victoria Beckham staple – alongside Low Slung Baggy Jean with drawstring details, Latch-Collar Denim Jacket, Denim Shirt Jacket and seasonal corduroy interpretations, priced from $118–$128. The collection's color palette was inspired by the art world, drawing inspiration from works in the Doris and Donald Fisher Collection at the San Francisco Museum of Modern Art. Charcoal, deep greens, warm browns, vamp reds and timeless neutrals bring a sophisticated seasonal point of view.


The accompanying campaign features still photography and video content of fashion model, Mona Tougaard and was developed under the creative direction of Calvin Leung, Gap’s Head of Creative, with styling by Alastair McKimm and photography by Glen Luchford. Its pared-back aesthetic places the focus on the silhouettes, fabrications and styling, capturing the refined confidence and sophisticated ease at the heart of the partnership.


The Gap × Victoria Beckham collection launches October 23rd at 9 a.m. ET / 6 a.m. PT on Gap.com and in select Gap stores globally, with prices ranging from $28 to $368. Encore cardmembers will also enjoy early access to shop the collection online and in the app on October 22nd 12p.m. ET/ 9 a.m. PT. The collection will be available across several global markets, including North America, the United Kingdom, Japan, China, Europe, Australia, and the Middle East.


**About Gap:**
Gap is a globally recognized icon of casual American style. Founded in San Francisco in 1969, Gap champions originality by creating loved essentials and delivering culturally relevant experiences that celebrate individuality. Gap is a lifestyle brand offering products across generations, including GapKids, babyGap, Gap Maternity, GapBody, GapFit, Gap Accessories and Gap Beauty, as well as GapStudio and partner collaborations through GapX. Gap is the namesake brand of the global specialty retailer, Gap Inc. (NYSE: GAP) and connects with customers online and in company-operated and franchise retail locations globally. **About Victoria Beckham:**
Founded in 2008 with a debut collection of dresses celebrated for their cut and fit, the house of Victoria Beckham has since evolved into a fully realised vision of modern luxury. Each collection is conceived in the London atelier, where refined silhouettes meet a distinctly contemporary sensibility.


What began with a single category now encompasses ready-to-wear, leather goods, accessories, and award-winning beauty — a universe built on the same principles of intent, craftsmanship, and sophisticated ease. Meticulously executed dresses, tailoring, and denim remain at the core of the offer, their considered construction subtly offset by unexpected details and fresh colour palettes.


With a flagship in Mayfair, ateliers in London and New York, and presence in over 230 stores worldwide, the house continues to earn international acclaim while shaping the modern woman’s wardrobe with a clear point of view.
